structure.unit: Other Sources of Energy; Energy Policy
Other Sources of Energy Generally; Energy Policy

law.catch_line: Nuclear energy; considered a clean energy source
law.text: For the purposes of the Commonwealth Clean Energy Policy as set out in § 45.2-1706.1, in any clean energy initiative or carbon-free energy initiative undertaken, overseen, regulated, or permitted by the Department, nuclear energy shall be considered to be a clean energy source.
